hints.title: Greedy Division Reductions
hints.text: Eating oranges one by one is slow. The optimal strategy is to reach multiples of 2 or 3 by eating few individual oranges, then divide.

hints.title: Two Recursive Choices
hints.text: From n, you can eat n % 2 oranges to reach a multiple of 2 and divide by 2, or eat n % 3 oranges to reach a multiple of 3 and divide by 3.

hints.title: Memoized Recursion
hints.text: The recurrence dp(n) = 1 + min(n % 2 + dp(n // 2), n % 3 + dp(n // 3)) with base cases dp(0) = 0 and dp(1) = 1 evaluates in logarithmic states.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: 1D DP array of size 2 * 10^9 causes memory allocation failure and time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sparse memoization branching by /2 and /3 only visits O((log N)^2) unique states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that subtraction is only useful to align with divisibility by 2 or 3.
complexity.notes: Logarithmic recursion handles numbers up to 2 billion.
